Sandbox_rSemiTruck_MilSpawnMultiplier_to:
Multiplies the spawn chance of all W900 military vehicles in every zone.
1.0 = default, 0.0 = never spawn, 2.0 = double chance.
Sandbox_rSemiTruck_AdminOnlyMoveUp_toolt: If enabled, only admins can use Move Up (unstuck). If disabled, players can use it on their own trucks when they are the driver or have the matching key.
